name: Software Testing and QA
certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering

beginner.summary: For new testers and people moving into QA. Covers why testing matters, the testing process, test levels and types, test design techniques, writing test cases, defect reporting, exploratory testing, API and database checks, agile testing, a first look at automation, and ISTQB Foundation preparation, ending with a full test cycle for a web application.
prerequisites: Comfortable using web and mobile applications
Basic understanding of how software is built
No programming experience needed for most days
outcomes: Plan and run tests using the testing process and ISTQB terms
Design test cases with black-box techniques
Report clear defects and track them to closure
Test web pages, APIs and data and take first steps in automation

days.topic: Software Testing Overview and Course Setup
subtopics: The application under test for the course
Setting up Jira and a test management tool
days.lab_task: Explore the course web application, list ten risks a user could face, log three real defects in Jira and set up the test project in the test management tool.
days.deliverable: Risk list, three defect reports and configured test project
checks: Each has steps, expected and actual results
Each risk linked to a principle

days.topic: The Test Process and Test Levels
subtopics: Unit, integration, system and acceptance testing
days.lab_task: Write a short test plan for the course app with scope, levels, entry and exit criteria and a traceability matrix from requirements to test cases.
days.deliverable: Test plan and traceability matrix
checks: Every requirement linked to at least one test
Explain the difference between system and acceptance testing

days.topic: Test Types: Functional, Non-Functional and Regression
days.lab_task: For three features, choose test types by risk, write a smoke suite and run a regression pass after a simulated bug fix.
days.deliverable: Test type matrix, smoke suite and regression results
checks: Fix confirmed and no new failures

days.topic: Test Design: Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis
days.lab_task: Design test cases for an age field, a discount rule and a file upload limit with partitions and boundaries, run them and report any defects.
days.deliverable: Partition and boundary tables, test cases and results
checks: All boundaries identified for each rule

days.topic: Test Design: Decision Tables, State Transitions and Use Cases
days.lab_task: Build a decision table for loan approval rules, a state diagram for an order life cycle and pairwise tests for browser and device combinations, then derive test cases.
days.deliverable: Decision table, state diagram, pairwise set and test cases
checks: System prevents it or a defect is logged

days.lab_task: Run two 60-minute exploratory sessions with charters on the course app, take notes, log defects and write session reports.
days.deliverable: Charters, notes, defects and session reports
checks: Each has a mission, area and time-box
At least three new defects found

days.topic: Writing Test Cases and Test Suites
days.lab_task: Write 30 test cases for checkout and account management, organise them into suites, review a partner's cases and fix issues found.
days.deliverable: Test suites and review comments
checks: Each has preconditions, steps and expected results
At least five issues found and fixed

days.topic: Defect Reporting and the Defect Life Cycle
subtopics: What makes a good defect report
days.lab_task: Report five defects with evidence and console logs, run a triage meeting role play to set severity and priority and follow one defect through to closure.
days.deliverable: Defect reports, triage notes and closed defect history
checks: Severity and priority set with reasons
Fix confirmed and status history complete

subtopics: Review types: informal, walkthrough, technical review, inspection
days.lab_task: Review a requirements document with a checklist, find ambiguous and untestable requirements, rewrite five of them and log review findings.
days.deliverable: Review log and rewritten requirements

days.lab_task: Test the course app on three browsers and two screen sizes, check forms, sessions and accessibility with DevTools and axe, and report defects.
days.deliverable: Compatibility matrix, accessibility results and defects
checks: Behaviour matches the requirement or a defect is logged

days.lab_task: Build a Postman collection for the course app API with environments, authentication, assertions for status, body and time, and run it with the collection runner.
days.deliverable: Postman collection and run results
checks: All passing tests green and failures reported

days.lab_task: Check that orders placed in the UI are stored correctly, find orphan records with joins and prepare and clean test data with SQL.
days.deliverable: SQL checks and results
checks: Place an order and query it

days.lab_task: Run a three amigos session for five user stories, write acceptance examples, plan testing across the quadrants and test the stories within a simulated sprint.
days.deliverable: Acceptance examples, test plan and sprint test results
checks: Each story has examples for normal and edge cases
All stories tested by sprint end

days.lab_task: Test the mobile version of the app on two emulated devices and one cloud device, including offline mode, rotation and an incoming call, and report defects.
days.deliverable: Device matrix, test results and defects
checks: Behaviour matches the requirement or a defect is logged
Data kept or a defect is logged

subtopics: What to automate and what not to
days.lab_task: Record a login and search flow with Selenium IDE and Playwright codegen, add assertions, run them and break one by changing a locator to see the maintenance cost.
days.deliverable: Two recorded tests and notes
checks: Choice justified by value and stability

days.topic: Performance Testing: Load, Stress and Response Times
days.lab_task: Build a JMeter test for the login and search API with 50 users, run it, read response times and throughput and compare them with the requirement.
days.deliverable: JMeter plan and results report
checks: Response times and error rate reported
Pass or fail stated with numbers
Point where response time rises sharply identified

days.lab_task: Run a ZAP baseline scan of the course app, test for broken access control by changing IDs in requests and report two security defects responsibly.
days.deliverable: ZAP report and security defects
checks: Other users' data accessible or not, recorded

days.lab_task: Estimate testing for a release, prioritise tests by risk, track execution for a simulated week and write a test completion report with a release recommendation.
days.deliverable: Estimate, risk-based plan, dashboard and completion report
checks: Recommendation backed by results and risks

days.lab_task: Take a 40-question timed ISTQB Foundation practice exam, review every wrong answer against the syllabus and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice score, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a syllabus section

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Full Test Cycle for a Web Application
days.lab_task: Run a complete test cycle for a new release of the course app: plan, design tests with techniques, execute UI, API and database tests, report defects, add two automated checks and present the completion report.
days.deliverable: Test plan, suites, defects, automated checks and a 10-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one test cycle
Test a release end to end

intermediate.summary: For testers with some experience who are moving into automation. Covers programming for testers, automation frameworks for web, API and mobile, behaviour-driven development, test data, CI/CD integration, performance and accessibility testing, contract testing, test strategy and ISTQB Advanced topics.
prerequisites: Has worked as a manual tester or on a QA team
Knows test design techniques and defect management
Basic programming in Python, Java or JavaScript
outcomes: Build maintainable automation for web, API and mobile
Run automated tests in CI/CD pipelines
Plan performance, accessibility and contract testing
Write test strategies for agile and DevOps teams

days.lab_task: Write a small program that reads test data from CSV and JSON, validates it and produces a summary report, with clean functions and error handling.
days.deliverable: Program and test data report
checks: Run on a file with bad rows
Small named functions and no copy-paste

days.lab_task: Automate login, search, add to cart and checkout with Selenium, use explicit waits and stable locators, and take screenshots on failure.
days.deliverable: Selenium test suite and run report

days.topic: Page Object Model and Framework Design
days.lab_task: Refactor the Selenium suite into a Page Object framework with configuration for environments, Allure reporting and shared components.
days.deliverable: Framework repository and Allure report
checks: Change a locator in one page object
All affected tests fixed by one change
Tests run against the other environment

days.lab_task: Rewrite the main flows in Playwright, mock a slow API response, run tests in parallel on three browsers and debug a failure with the trace viewer.
days.deliverable: Playwright suite, trace and run report
checks: Run on three browsers in parallel
Cause found in the trace viewer

subtopics: REST Assured or requests with pytest
Negative and boundary tests for APIs
tools: REST Assured or pytest with requests
days.lab_task: Build an automated API test suite with schema validation, data-driven tests from CSV, an OAuth token flow and negative tests, and report the results.
days.deliverable: API suite and report
checks: Errors handled as specified or defects logged

days.lab_task: Write feature files for checkout with business-readable scenarios, implement step definitions and generate living documentation.
days.deliverable: Feature files, step definitions and documentation
checks: Several examples run from one scenario

days.lab_task: Generate synthetic customers and orders with Faker, mask a copy of production-like data and make the automated tests create and clean their own data.
days.deliverable: Data generators, masked data and updated tests

subtopics: Running tests in GitHub Actions or Jenkins
days.lab_task: Run the UI and API suites in a CI pipeline on every pull request with sharding, publish reports and block merges when tests fail.
days.deliverable: Pipeline configuration and run evidence
checks: Open a pull request with a failing test

subtopics: Running on emulators and device clouds
days.lab_task: Automate login and search on the mobile app with Appium using page objects, run on an emulator and a cloud device and handle a swipe gesture.
days.deliverable: Appium suite and run reports

days.topic: Performance Testing with JMeter and k6
days.lab_task: Model a peak-hour workload, script it in JMeter with correlation and in k6 with thresholds, run it while monitoring the server and identify the bottleneck.
days.deliverable: Scripts, results and bottleneck analysis
checks: Run fails when p95 is above the limit

days.lab_task: Audit three pages against WCAG 2.2 with axe, keyboard-only use and a screen reader, report issues by success criterion and add axe checks to the automated suite.
days.deliverable: Accessibility audit and automated checks

days.topic: Contract and Integration Testing for Microservices
days.lab_task: Write consumer contracts for the order service's call to inventory with Pact, verify the provider, and test against a WireMock stub and a containerised database.
days.deliverable: Contracts, verification results and integration tests
checks: Tests pass without the real service
Database created and cleaned per run

subtopics: When visual tests are worth it
days.lab_task: Add visual tests for five key pages, mask dynamic areas, introduce a CSS change and review the diff to approve or reject it.
days.deliverable: Visual test suite and review record
checks: No false failures from changing dates

days.topic: Test Strategy for Agile and DevOps Teams
days.lab_task: Write a test strategy for a product team moving to weekly releases, including levels, automation targets, environments, shift-right practices and metrics.
days.deliverable: Test strategy document
checks: Every risk area has a testing approach

days.topic: Testing in Production and Observability for QA
subtopics: Using logs and traces in testing
days.lab_task: Add synthetic checks for the main user journey, verify a canary release with metrics and traces and roll back when the error rate rises.
days.deliverable: Synthetic checks, canary review and rollback record
checks: Error rate compared with the stable version
Rollback done when the threshold is crossed

days.lab_task: Test a provided ETL pipeline with source-to-target reconciliation, quality rules in Great Expectations and transformation tests, and report data defects.
days.deliverable: Test suite, reconciliation results and defects

days.lab_task: Use AI to generate test cases and Playwright tests for a new feature, review and fix them, and compare coverage and time against writing them by hand.
days.deliverable: AI-generated tests, review notes and comparison

days.topic: Defect Prevention, Metrics and Quality Reporting
subtopics: Root cause analysis of escaped defects
days.lab_task: Analyse escaped defects from three releases, find root causes, build a quality dashboard and propose three prevention actions.
days.deliverable: Root cause analysis, dashboard and actions
checks: Each linked to a root cause

days.topic: ISTQB Advanced and Agile Tester Exam Preparation
days.lab_task: Take timed practice exams for an ISTQB Advanced module and Agile Tester, review wrong answers and plan study.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a syllabus section

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Automation Framework and CI Pipeline
days.lab_task: Build a framework with web, API and mobile tests, managed test data, a contract test, accessibility and performance checks, all running in CI with reports and gates, then present it.
days.deliverable: Framework repository, pipeline, reports and a 15-minute demo
checks: All test types run and report
Correct tests fail and the merge is blocked
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one framework

advanced.summary: For senior QA engineers, SDETs, test architects and QA leads. Covers test architecture at scale, advanced automation design, performance engineering, chaos and resilience testing, security test automation, testing AI and ML systems, quality engineering in DevOps, test environments and data at scale, QA leadership, metrics and building a QA function.
prerequisites: Builds and maintains automation frameworks in CI
Knows performance, API and contract testing
Has led testing for a product or release
outcomes: Architect test automation and environments for large systems
Lead performance, resilience and security testing
Lead quality engineering and QA teams

days.lab_task: Design the test architecture for a 40-service platform with shared libraries, environments, data and reporting, and record the main decisions.
days.deliverable: Test architecture and decision records
checks: Every layer and quality attribute covered
Each high risk has a testing approach

days.lab_task: Refactor part of a 500-test suite to the screenplay pattern with builders and dependency injection, make it parallel-safe and measure run time and maintenance effort.
days.deliverable: Refactored suite and measurements

days.topic: Flaky Tests and Test Reliability Engineering
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of CI results to find flaky tests, quarantine them, fix the top five causes and set a reliability target with monitoring.
days.deliverable: Flaky test analysis, fixes and reliability dashboard
checks: Each passes 50 runs in a row
Flaky rate shown on a dashboard

subtopics: Load, stress, spike and soak tests
days.lab_task: Build a production-like workload model, run load, spike and soak tests with server profiling, find two bottlenecks and produce a capacity plan.
days.deliverable: Workload model, test results, bottleneck analysis and capacity plan
checks: Instance counts for the target load

subtopics: Fault injection: latency, errors, instance loss
days.lab_task: Define steady state for a service, inject latency, pod loss and dependency failure, measure the impact and run a game day with the team.
days.deliverable: Experiment plans, results and game day report
checks: Service stays within its SLO or the gap is recorded
Timeouts and fallbacks work or a defect is logged

days.lab_task: Add DAST, API fuzzing and an automated authorisation test matrix to the pipeline, triage the findings and agree gates with the security team.
days.deliverable: Security tests in the pipeline, triage log and gate rules
checks: Every role tested against every endpoint

days.lab_task: Test an order flow across three services and Kafka, check idempotency with duplicate events, wait correctly for eventual consistency and use traces to find a failure.
days.deliverable: Test suite, idempotency results and trace analysis
checks: No fixed sleeps, polling with timeouts

days.topic: Testing AI and Machine Learning Systems
days.lab_task: Test an ML classifier with metamorphic and fairness tests and an LLM assistant with an evaluation set and prompt injection tests, and report the findings.
days.deliverable: Test suites and findings report

days.topic: Test Environments and Infrastructure as Code
days.lab_task: Create ephemeral test environments per pull request with infrastructure as code, seed them with data, run tests and tear them down automatically.
days.deliverable: Environment code, pipeline and cost report
checks: Environment created and tests run in it
Merge or close the pull request

days.topic: Test Data at Scale and Privacy
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that subsets and masks production-like data with referential integrity, versions it and provides it to three test environments.
days.deliverable: Data pipeline, versioned datasets and privacy check

days.lab_task: Map quality activities to every pipeline stage for a team, measure DORA and quality metrics and propose a plan to move testing left and right.
days.deliverable: Quality map, metrics and plan
checks: Shift-left and shift-right actions with owners

days.lab_task: Model the order life cycle and generate tests from it, then write property-based tests for the pricing rules and fix the bugs they find.
days.deliverable: Model, generated tests, property tests and bug fixes

days.topic: Mobile Testing at Scale with Device Farms
subtopics: Choosing a device coverage matrix from usage data
Real devices versus emulators at scale
Device farms: BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm
Testing app updates and OS upgrades
days.lab_task: Build a device matrix from analytics data, run the Appium suite in parallel on 15 real devices in a device farm, test an OS upgrade path and compare cost against coverage.
days.deliverable: Device matrix, parallel run results and cost comparison
checks: Devices cover the agreed share of users
Results per device with failures triaged

days.lab_task: Build an accessibility programme for a product with process, automation, manual testing and training, and produce a conformance report for one release.
days.deliverable: Programme design and conformance report
checks: Issues by severity tracked over releases

days.topic: QA Leadership and Building a QA Function
days.lab_task: Design a QA function for a 60-engineer organisation with structure, roles, skills matrix, tooling budget and a six-month plan to improve quality culture.
days.deliverable: QA function design and plan

days.topic: Quality Metrics, Economics and Reporting to Leadership
days.lab_task: Calculate the cost of quality and the return on automation for a product, define quality OKRs and present a release readiness report to a mock leadership team.
days.deliverable: Cost model, OKRs and presentation
checks: Based on stated effort and savings

subtopics: Regulated testing needs: finance, healthcare, aviation
days.lab_task: Plan risk-based validation for a regulated healthcare application with traceability, evidence rules and validated automation, and pass a mock audit.
days.deliverable: Validation plan, traceability and audit result
checks: Requirement, risk, test and evidence linked

days.topic: Test Automation Tool Selection and Migration
days.lab_task: Evaluate two tools against criteria with a proof of concept, plan the migration of a 300-test suite and migrate 20 tests with measured effort.
days.deliverable: Evaluation, migration plan and pilot results
checks: All pass in the new tool

subtopics: Release go or no-go under pressure
days.lab_task: Handle three injected crises before a release (a critical escaped defect, a failing suite and an environment outage), make the go or no-go call and run the review.
days.deliverable: Crisis log, decision and review report
checks: Make the go or no-go call

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Quality Engineering Strategy for a Platform
days.lab_task: Produce and prove a quality engineering strategy for a microservices platform with test architecture, ephemeral environments, performance, chaos and security testing, AI testing, metrics and a leadership presentation.
days.deliverable: Strategy, working pipeline, test reports and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Functional, performance and security tests run with gates
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one strategy
